# Depth and Reinforcement Learning in Embodied Scenarios

This directory collects tutorial materials for the reproduction of reinforcement learning, imitation learning, and deep learning in embodied scenarios. It is recommended that you first understand the task boundaries and simulation platforms, and then proceed to the specific code and training commands.

## Chapter Entry

- [ Reinforcement learning for multi-robot furniture handling reproduction](01-reinforcement-learning-for-multi-robot-furniture-handling.md): Introduction to the CooHOI collaborative humanoid robot handling task.
- [ HIMLoco quadruped robot motion control reproduction on Isaac Lab](02-himloco-isaaclab-reproduction/README.md): Understanding from the paper, troubleshooting of the old Isaac Gym stack, to the new Isaac Lab stack smoke test.
- [ AGILE humanoid robot Loco-Manipulation on Isaac Lab reproduction](03-agile-humanoid-robot-loco-manipulation-reproduction/README.md): Understanding the AGILE humanoid robot RL workflow, official task boundaries, local Isaac Sim 5.1 replication video, and evaluation export pipeline.
- [ "Robots That Know What to Ask" reward alignment guide](04-robots-that-know-what-to-ask-reward-alignment-introduction/README.md): Analyzing how ASQ identifies under-specification reward features during teaching and explains them in natural language to guide humans to provide corrective demonstrations.
- [ Open Duck Mini and Microduck bipedal reinforcement learning](05-open-duck-mini-and-microduck-biped-rl/README.md): Distinguishing between the two generations of duck robot models, completing URDF/STL asset download, Microduck PPO smoke test, formal training, video replay, and ONNX export pipeline.
- [ SMP reusable score-matching motion priors](06-smp-reusable-score-matching-motion-priors/README.md): Explains how SDS, ESM, Adaptive Normalization, and GSI turn a motion diffusion model into a PPO reward, with both the original MimicKit route and the open Unitree G1 reproduction.

## Learning Recommendations

If you are new to reinforcement learning for robots, first read HIMLoco to understand proprioception, privileged critics, and sim-to-real. Then use Open Duck Mini/Microduck for a smaller bipedal training exercise with clear assets and commands. Continue with SMP to understand how a motion diffusion model becomes a reusable prior reward, and then study AGILE for a more complete humanoid task configuration, teacher-student distillation, evaluation reports, and Sim2MuJoCo review. Readers interested in VLA, world-model post-training, or human demonstrations can continue with Robots That Know What to Ask, focusing on reward misalignment, under-specified features, and human-in-the-loop reward correction.
